item.title: eMudhra security incident: MeitY orders probe, says impact on Indian websites and apps was limited; details here
item.description: MeitY has ordered a probe into the eMudhra security incident involving eight compromised digital certificates. The ministry said the impact on Indian websites and apps was limited and clarified that domestic digital signature services were not affected.

item.title: eMudhra intermediate CA certificates compromised: What happened, who is affected and what users need to know | Explained
item.description: CERT-In has warned that eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates were compromised due to weak cryptographic keys. Here's how fraudulent certificates could threaten encrypted communications and what users and website administrators should do.

item.title: Elon Musk's X to pay creators ₹2.85 lakh for 15 videos in 30 days: Check eligibility, rules and deadline to enrol
item.description: X is piloting an invite-only Video Kickstart Bonus that pays eligible creators a fixed $3,000 for regularly posting original videos. Details of the programme here.&nbsp;

item.title: iPhone 17 Pro 256GB gets a big discount: How to buy it at ₹56,990 on Reliance Digital? Check eligibility and more
item.description: Reliance Digital advertises the 256GB iPhone 17 Pro at an effective ₹56,990, down from its ₹1,34,900 launch price. The offer combines an in-store discount, eligible smartphone exchange value and bonus, and qualifying bank cashback; it is not a flat discount for all buyers.

item.title: Dell's latest 14-inch laptop brings 120Hz screen and long battery life at lower starting price — details here
item.description: Dell has launched the 14S DS14270 laptop globally, with prices starting at $649 in the US. It is powered by Intel Wildcat Lake processors. The 14-inch laptop offers up to 16GB RAM, 1TB storage and an optional 120Hz display, while weighing just 1.15kg.

item.title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge effectively available at ₹30,399 on Amazon with exchange offer: Check deal details
item.description: Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge is available on Amazon at ₹67,999, down from its listed price of ₹1,09,999. With an exchange value of up to ₹37,600, buyers can get the smartphone at an effective price of ₹30,399.

item.title: Google, Apple and Mozilla block 8 eMudhra certificates over weak keys: What users need to know
item.description: Google, Apple and Mozilla have blocked eight digital certificates issued by the Indian certificate authority eMudhra after researchers found dangerously weak private keys. The flaw could let attackers impersonate websites.&nbsp;

item.title: Tech giants AI spending to exceed USD 1 trillion in 2027, lift US growth: UBS
item.description: Investment by major technology companies in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure is expected to exceed USD 1 trillion in 2027 as demand for computing capacity continues to outstrip supply, supporting US economic growth despite rising financing needs, according to a report by UBS.

item.title: Samsung One UI 9.0 rolls out to Galaxy S23 in Europe: Is your phone eligible?
item.description: Samsung has begun rolling out the stable Android 17-based One UI 9.0 update to the Galaxy S23 series in Europe, starting with beta programme users. The 516.69 MB update brings Quick Panel customisation, a location privacy indicator and new AI features.

item.title: Enterprise software costs threaten AI investment, innovation as firms spend 28% of budgets on unwanted changes: Report
item.description: Large enterprises may face growing constraints on innovation and artificial intelligence (AI) investments as vendor-driven software upgrades, migrations and licensing changes consume an average of 28 per cent of their software budgets, according to a report by Origina published in collaboration with Thinkers50.

item.title: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple wearable pre-orders open November 1: How to order, expected price, colours and features
item.description: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple wearable will open pre-orders on November 1, 2026, with six colour options planned for the launch edition. The device uses optical sensors to track cerebral blood flow and generates an Entropy score to indicate physiological strain.

item.title: Apple’s ‘Pro and tell’ event on October 28: Touchscreen MacBook Pro, M6 Macs, iPad mini
item.description: Apple has announced a product launch event in Los Angeles, teasing new devices under the tagline ‘Pro and tell’. The company is expected to unveil a touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro, an M6-powered iMac and the iPad mini 8 with an OLED display.

item.title: iQOO Neo 12 to launch on October 28: Design, colours, display and key specs revealed
item.description: iQOO Neo 12 will launch in China on October 28, 2026, featuring a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and a 2K OLED display with a 185Hz refresh rate. The gaming-focused smartphone features a dedicated Q3 gaming chip, an integrated cooling fan and three colour options.

item.title: Just 6,000 units, ₹50,000 extra: why Apple’s iPhone Duo could be hard to get
item.description: With just 6,000 units expected in India in its first week, Apple’s ₹2.99 lakh foldable iPhone is commanding grey-market premiums of up to ₹50,000, driven by scarcity and status-seeking buyers.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro vs Sony ZV-E10 II: Which should you buy for photography and content creation? All features explained
item.description: Choosing between the iPhone 18 Pro and Sony ZV-E10 II depends on your needs. The iPhone is portable and simple to use, with versatile built-in cameras and effective video stabilisation. Sony offers more control over lenses, depth of field and image character, but requires more setup.

item.title: AI agents can pose insider security risks even without being hacked: Microsoft
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents deployed within companies could pose significant internal security risks even without being compromised by hackers, Microsoft has warned, calling for continuous monitoring of autonomous AI systems as their use across enterprises grows.

item.title: iPhone Duo vs iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max: Check price, camera features, battery and display differences
item.description: The iPhone Duo sold out within minutes of preorders opening, with online orders facing waits until January 2027. Compared with the iPhone 18 Pro Max, it offers a larger foldable display and titanium frame, while the Pro Max has more cameras, advanced photography features and a lower starting price.

item.title: Apple iPad A16 gets a price cut on Amazon: How to buy it for under ₹43,250 during the Great Indian Festival 2026
item.description: Amazon is offering a bank discount of ₹2,750, in addition to a price reduction of more than ₹3,900. These offers could make the tablet a more affordable option for those planning to buy an iPad.

item.title: Mint Explainer: What makes a cloud sovereign?
item.description: As AI transforms computing infrastructure into a strategic asset, India is building a sovereign-cloud policy—raising the question of whether local data storage is enough without full control over physical hardware, encryption, and jurisdiction.

item.title: Only 8% of fund managers report improved investment returns from AI adoption: Morgan Stanley–Oliver Wyman
item.description: Despite growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in the global asset management industry, only 8 per cent of fund managers have reported measurable improvements in investment returns, according to a joint research report by Morgan Stanley and Oliver Wyman.
